nodes.name: Report Email Webhook
nodes.notes: Called by /api/send-report, both from the Reports screen's Send button and from the weekly automation.

nodes.name: Get Sender Address
nodes.notes: Connect the Gmail OAuth2 credential. The sending Gmail address, for the From line.

nodes.name: Build Email With Thread Headers
nodes.notes: email.headers (References, In-Reply-To, Thread-Topic) come from the app.

nodes.name: Send Report with Gmail
nodes.notes: Connect the same Gmail OAuth2 credential. email.to is already a comma separated list of validated addresses.
